labels.calendarSyncModeHelp: Background calendar sync stays **off**. Export events with **Add to Google Calendar** on each record. Showing personal Google events inside the CRM calendar uses the multi-select above (separate from export routing).
labels.googleAccountProfileMissing: Connected with an older authorization. Reconnect this Google account to show its email, name and avatar.
labels.googleConnectWarningText:
Google will show an *"unverified app"* warning because this CRM integration is **not** published on Google's public verification program.

**This is expected for Safehouse CRM.** Continuing past Advanced → Go to (app) (unsafe) is appropriate **only** for this Safehouse application that your organization configured.

If **another** website or app shows a similar unverified-app / Advanced warning when you connect Google, treat that as a red flag: prefer **not** to connect, or continue only at your own risk.

During Connect: click **Advanced**, then **Go to (app name) (unsafe)**, then approve access. Connect only accounts you manage yourself.
labels.googleConnectRiskCheckboxLabel: I have read this warning and understand the risks
labels.googleConnectRiskCheckboxRequired: Check "I have read this warning and understand the risks" before connecting.
labels.oauthSafetyAckHint: Connect / Reconnect stay disabled until this box is checked. You do **not** need to enable **Enabled** first. After you connect, the checkbox locks until you disconnect.
labels.overlayCalendarIdListHelp: Choose which **personal** Google calendars to show inside the CRM calendar. Calendars created by the CRM are never listed here. Default: primary calendar only. Overlay events older than 1 month are removed automatically.
labels.allowManagerGoogleCalendarWriteHelp: When enabled, Admin or Manager users may export association events into **your** Google Calendar from CRM records. Off by default. Your own exports never require this setting.
labels.calendarRoutingDescPrimary: All manual exports go to your **primary** Google calendar (the one Google marks as primary). The CRM does **not** create a dedicated calendar. Admin naming prefix `{prefix}` / suffix `{suffix}` is unused in this mode.
labels.calendarRoutingDescUserPick: On each record you choose an existing Google calendar or create one. When the CRM suggests a new calendar name, it follows the admin pattern, e.g. **{exampleName}** (prefix `{prefix}`, entity label, suffix `{suffix}`; empty parts are omitted).
labels.calendarRoutingDescAutoDedicated: **Recommended default.** The CRM creates or reuses one dedicated Google calendar per entity type, named like **{exampleName}** (admin prefix `{prefix}` + entity label such as `{entityLabel}` + suffix `{suffix}`). Empty prefix/suffix parts are omitted.

help.GoogleCalendarDrive:
**How to connect**
1. Read the warning and check the confirmation box.
2. Click **Connect** (Enabled can stay off until after OAuth).
3. In Google: Advanced → Go to app (unsafe) → allow access.
4. Verify email / name / avatar, turn **Enabled** on, click **Save**.

**While connected:** **Reconnect** switches Google account; **Disconnect** clears tokens (same as turning Enabled off + Save).

**Calendar:** Export is manual only (**Add to Google Calendar** on records). Prefer **Dedicated calendar (auto)** so CRM-created calendars follow the admin prefix/suffix. Use **Calendars to show in CRM** to overlay personal Google events into the CRM calendar.

tooltips.calendarRoutingMode: Primary = always your main Google calendar. I pick = choose/create per record. Dedicated (auto) = CRM creates/reuses one calendar per entity type using admin prefix/suffix.
tooltips.overlayCalendarIdList: Personal calendars to overlay into the CRM calendar. CRM-managed calendars cannot be selected.
